name: AI Image Changer
tagline: AI image changer: upload a photo, describe what to change in plain words, compare the result and download your edited image.
description: AI Image Changer is an online AI photo editor driven by simple text prompts. Upload a JPG, PNG or WebP photo (up to 5 MB), pick a preset or write one specific instruction, choose a model, then compare the result side by side with your original and download it or keep editing. Focused tools cover hair color, background replacement, image style (watercolor, illustration, clay and more), single-color changes, age and body edits, plus AI video. Works for portraits, products, pets, food and interiors. Sign in with Google to get bonus credits; each image costs 1 credit, with optional monthly plans and one-time credit packs.
